annotations.title: Startup Legal & IP Assignment Diligence Scorer

description: Audits C-Corp filings, 83(b) timeliness, PIIA IP assignments, cleanroom code provenance, cap table cleanliness, and OSS licensing before pitching VCs. Same math as https://modevc.com/tools/startup-legal-diligence-ip-calculator.

cap_table_clean.description: No unrecorded side letters. Default true.

cleanroom_ip.description: Built off employer hours/equipment. Default true.

entity_formed.description: Delaware C-Corp formed with consents. Default true.

no_gpl_conflict.description: No copyleft GPL risk. Default true.

piia_signed.description: PIIA IP assignment coverage. Default all_signed.
